title: FineServe：细粒度全球LLM服务负载数据集与特征分析
summary: FineServe是一个从全球商业市场收集的多模型LLM服务负载数据集，支持细粒度特征分析。揭示了不同模型架构、规模和任务意图下的到达动态和令牌行为差异，并开发了可配置的工作负载生成器，为多模型服务平台的路由、调度和容量规划策略评估提供现实基础。
summary_en: FineServe is a fine-grained, multi-model LLM serving workload dataset collected from a global commercial marketplace. It reveals distinct fluctuation regimes across model architectures, scales, and task intents, and provides a configurable workload generator for benchmarking routing, scheduling, and capacity-planning strategies.
